- Preserved Custom model blacklist and Codex configuration in the affected frontend views.
- Registered the v0.2.9 Vendor baseline, refreshed the Custom delta/thin-bridge/database ledgers, and retained the existing shadow mappings.
- Kept the official gateway, billing, scheduler, Antigravity, apicompat, model plaza, UI, and Docker updates while reviewing all Custom overlaps.

## Database

- The official `vendor-0.2.8` to `v0.2.9` diff adds no migration, Ent schema, entity field, SQL, or installation-script change.
- No production DDL or DML was executed. No production migration is required for this upgrade; deployment should still run the normal read-only schema fingerprint gate.
